# proxmox_qemu_vncproxy (Data Source)

Requests a VNC proxy for a VM from `/nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/vncproxy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_qemu_vncproxy" "v" {
  node = "pve-1"
  vmid = 300
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `vmid` (Number)

### Optional

- `generate_password` (Boolean)
- `websocket` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `result` (String)
